interpretation.earned: The full native G60 automorphism group contains automorphisms fixing a under conjugation while exchanging b and ab. Therefore the chi_b and chi_ab character sectors are related by an exact native character-exchange symmetry.
interpretation.spectral_consequence: Because the graph Laplacian commutes with every graph automorphism, a symmetry exchanging chi_b and chi_ab forces those two restricted Laplacians to be isospectral.
